newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S.C. Strategic in HK$113 mln rights plan.
newsitem.headline: S.C. Strategic in HK$113 mln rights plan.

text.p: South China Strategic Ltd said it planned to raise about HK$113.4 million before expenses by issuing 567.11 million rights shares on the basis of one rights share for every two existing shares held at HK$0.20 each.

Of the HK$109.8 million net proceeds, HK$40 million will be used to invest in properties in Hong Kong and China, HK$30 million for the purchase of equipment and for promotion of the Express News, a local Chinese-language newspaper, it said.
It said another HK$10 million would be used for general working capital for its magazine Surprise Weekly and the balance would be for repayment of bank borrowings and working capital.
As at January 20, 1997, the total number of the company shares in issue was about 1.13 billion shares, it said.
The rights issue is expected to be completed on March 14, 1997 and the register of members will be closed from February 10 to 17.
Trading in the company shares resumed on Thursday after a two day suspension. Its shares fell HK$0.036 or 14.12 percent to HK$0.219 in mid-morning.
South China Strategic also said it had decided to withdraw a reorganisation proposal due to the continued delay in implementing the proposals.

"The directors have no intention to put a new proposal which involves a reduction of capital of the company, cancellation of shares premium account of the company and a change of domicile of the company before shareholders again in the near future," managing director Simon Tam in the statement.
